description.value: Tacos La Cantina is an authentic Mexican taqueria founded by Whistler local Pepe Barajas, with its flagship location in the Village Marketplace. The menu centres on fresh tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and legendary margaritas made daily, with a strong lineup of gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian choices. A lively, casual atmosphere and quick-service format make it a practical and satisfying stop for hungry cyclists passing through the Village.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms two Whistler locations; the OSM record corresponds to the Village Marketplace location at 129-4340 Lorimer Road. The website explicitly advertises takeout/pickup and prominently lists gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian options across the menu. No bike-specific parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'La Cantina' but the business brands itself as 'Tacos La Cantina' on its website and domain.
Postal code mismatch: OSM has V0N 1B4, website consistently shows V8E 1A5. Address updated to website value.
OSM has no phone number; 604-962-9950 sourced from website for the Village Marketplace location.
Two locations in Whistler (Village Marketplace and Nesters Plaza); this OSM record corresponds to the Village Marketplace location only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-reviewed restaurant in Whistler Village with takeout service and strong vegetarian/vegan/GF options — a practical refuelling stop for touring cyclists. Bike-parking details are unconfirmed but the location warrants inclusion pending on-the-ground verification.
